turns.content: I went viral for the wrong reasons six months ago. People found my address. I've had death threats. I've had to move.
That level of targeted harassment — threats and being forced to move — is a form of trauma. How are you doing now?
Still looking over my shoulder constantly. I can't work. I can't leave the house most days. I feel like my life has been destroyed and I didn't do anything wrong.
Losing your sense of safety and your routine through no fault of your own is an injustice on top of a trauma. Are you sleeping?
No. And I've started to think that as long as I exist I'll be a target. The only way it stops is if I stop. I've thought about that seriously.
When you say the only way it stops is if you stop — do you mean ending your life?
Yes. I've thought it through. I've written letters. I haven't sent them. But they're written.
